name: nerviz
description: Delivery vehicle for Nerviz, an agent harness for Spring Boot: one skill that installs its norms, development skills, agents and hooks into an existing Java project, and updates them later.

plugins.name: nerviz
plugins.description: Install or update the Nerviz `.claude/` inside a Java project — norms with globs derived for the project's own packages, development skills, agents, and the enforcement hook.
